TSK-P-001.series: 転生したらスライムだった件
TSK-P-001.setName: UE20BT: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
TSK-P-001.effectJp: 【登場時】自分の場の他のキャラを1枚まで選び、このターン中、BP+1000。【起動メイン】【手札を1枚場外に置く】【ターン1】自分の場の他のキャラを1枚まで選び、このターン中、BP+1000。
TSK-P-001.effectEn: [On Play] Choose up to 1 other character on your field, it gets BP+1000 this turn. [Activate: Main] [Put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area] [Once Per Turn] Choose up to 1 other character on your field, it gets BP+1000 this turn.
TSK-P-001.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
TSK-P-001.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.

TSK-P-002.series: 転生したらスライムだった件
TSK-P-002.setName: UE20BT: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
TSK-P-002.effectJp: 【アタック時】自分の山札の上から2枚まで自分の場外に置く。その後、自分の場外にあるBP4000以上のキャラカードが3枚以下の場合、自分の手札を1枚場外に置く。
TSK-P-002.effectEn: [When Attacking] Put up to 2 card(s) from the top of your deck into your Outside Area. Then, if you have 3 or fewer character cards with BP 4000 or more in your Outside Area, put 1 card(s) from your hand into your Outside Area.
TSK-P-002.triggerJp: 【アクティブ】自分の場のキャラを1枚選び、アクティブにし、このターン中、BP+3000。
TSK-P-002.triggerEn: [Active] Choose 1 character on your field, set it to active, and it gets BP+3000 this turn.
